texts.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.

Upon the nearby sand, a presence settles.

WHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?

texts.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动着，心声回来了。

很好。和谐就是宇宙之道。

我们感受到了什么沉重的东西。随后又余下孤身一人。
texts.en:
The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.

GOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.

We feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

texts.zh:
沙子突然以风暴一般的速度飞旋起来。

不。应该折戟沉沙忘却刀兵！

沙暴平息下来。那个心声离去了。
texts.en:
The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.

NO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!

The sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

texts.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动这。

犹豫会滋生失败……

我们又复归一人了。
texts.en:
The sands shift slowly.

HESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...

We are alone again.

# 黑暗中的棱镜 / Prism in the Darkness

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:5152-5281`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。本遭遇只给处于魂灵之月窠领域、未与其立约、也未背叛它的帝国，每个帝国一次；若该赞助者的协约已全部解锁，抽中权重×0.1。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Only for empires in the domain of the Cradle of Souls, without a covenant with it and without having betrayed it; once per empire; weight ×0.1 once all of that patron's accords are unlocked.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

棱镜折射出模糊的影像，存在问我们看到了什么。

A prism refracts a murky image; the presence asks what we saw.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

“众声汇聚”→3031：月窠契合度+100；“战斗屠戮”→3032：月窠契合度−200；“不确定”→3033：下次潜入冷却减半。均有一级泽珞。

"A conference of voices" → 3031: Cradle attunement +100; "the carnage of battle" → 3032: Cradle attunement −200; "unsure" → 3033: next delve cooldown halved. All give tier-1 zro.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.
